title: 'Each upkeep' triggers fire on every player's upkeep, scoped by the active player
setup: Four-seat turn order with a clock. Control Pest Rescuer and Beledros Witherbloom. Advance through one full round (four upkeeps) with no Pest tokens at the start.
provisional_expectation: Beledros creates one Pest at each of the four upkeeps (4 total). Pest Rescuer triggers only at an upkeep where its controller controls no Pest creature token (603.4 intervening-if at trigger and resolution). With Rescuer resolving first at the first upkeep: 2 tokens, then 1,1,1. The kernel's player-agnostic begin_upkeep() currently reproduces this only under caller discipline.
trace_requirements: trigger admission per source per upkeep
Rescuer predicate at admission and resolution
controls: Pest token present before the round: Rescuer never triggers, Beledros still fires four times.

title: Mana pools empty at the end of each step and phase
setup: Add {B}{G} during the first main phase; pass to combat without spending.
provisional_expectation: The pool is empty when combat begins (106.4). Mana added in the upkeep is not available in the draw step. The kernel currently never empties a pool (A05; test_mana_pool_not_emptied_by_any_turn_reset).
controls: Spend before the boundary: no loss.

title: State-based actions are checked when a player would receive priority, between resolutions, not inside one
setup: Resolve an effect that puts a -1/-1 counter on a 1/1 and then draws (Yawgmoth). Separately, resolve a single effect that creates two 1-toughness tokens and then gives each -1/-1 (synthetic).
provisional_expectation: Death happens after the whole effect resolves (704.3, 117.5); triggers from that death go on the stack afterwards. In the synthetic case both tokens die simultaneously as one SBA event; their death triggers see each other (603.10 look-back).

title: 'Your end step' triggers do not fire during opponents' end steps
setup: Clock with four seats. Control Moseo (with life gained) and Ribtruss Roaster (counters 2). Advance through an opponent's end step, then your own.
provisional_expectation: No Moseo or Roaster trigger at the opponent's end step; both at yours. Moseo's intervening-if is checked at your end step only. The kernel currently fires roaster_end_step()/moseo_end_step() whenever called.
trace_requirements: active player at each end step
controls: Beledros fires at both players' upkeeps for contrast.

title: Ribtruss Roaster trigger uses last known information when Roaster leaves before resolution
setup: Roaster with two +1/+1 counters; at your end step the trigger goes on the stack; in response Roaster is destroyed.
provisional_expectation: The trigger resolves and creates two Pests using Roaster's last known counter count (608.2h). The promoted R47 branch currently creates none (test_kernel_observed_makes_nothing).
controls: Counter removed before Roaster leaves: LKI reflects the removal.
